description: Excel-anchor tier (OPERATIONS §6): whole-workspace value-equivalence — a workspace recomputes equal to Excel, per node. Executed via OxXlPlay (construct + observe Excel) + OxReplay (diff + govern); Excel comparison is never reimplemented here. `expect.excel_values` are the canonical Excel-truth assertions. This is the W008 gate: an imported defined-names workbook must recompute equal to Excel.

cases.name: the accounts workspace recomputes equal to Excel
